mapping.draft_py:
# Dread Presence (M20)
# "Whenever a Swamp you control enters, choose one —
#   • You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
#   • This creature deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life."
# event: Landfall's ZoneChangeEvent (B7-landfall-trigger) with the land-type noun "Swamp" = SUBTYPE_EQ Swamp +
#        TYPE_EQ Land (the guide's tribal-noun convention: subtype plus its card type; no land-type precedent parses).
# modes: Elder Gargaroth's Choose(count=QConst(1), options=(...)); each mode is a Seq in printed order.
# atoms: B5a-draw-one, B4-lose-life-n, B5b-damage-any (Shock's any-target selector), B4-gain-life-n.
swamp_enters = ZoneChangeEvent(
    from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
    to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
    subject=FAnd(
        children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Swamp'),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
        ),
    ),
)
any_target = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
    filter=FOr(
        children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Planeswalker'),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Player'),
        ),
    ),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
mode_draw = Seq(
    steps=(
        A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        A(Verb.LOSE_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
    ),
)
mode_burn = Seq(
    steps=(
        A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {'amount': QConst(value=2), 'target': any_target}),
        A(Verb.GAIN_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=2), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
    ),
)
swamp_trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=swamp_enters,
    condition=None,
    effect=Choose(count=QConst(value=1), options=(mode_draw, mode_burn)),
)
abilities = [swamp_trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever a Swamp you control enters, choose one —
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
• This creature deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.

mapping.notes: Engine (reported by mapper): a modal trigger designates and journals the target of its targeted mode before the mode is asked, even when the other mode is chosen; with no legal target the targeted mode is still offered (CR 700.2a). Packs in the mapper scratch dir.

clauses.clause: Whenever a Swamp you control enters, choose one —
clauses.evidence: abilities[0] = ZoneChangeEvent(to battlefield/YOU, subject FAnd(CONTROLLER_IS YOU, SUBTYPE_EQ Swamp, TYPE_EQ Land)) -> Choose(1, two Seq options). No stimulus puts a Swamp onto the battlefield ([stimulus: you play a land -> none], [a creature enters under your control -> none]: the probe's land is not a Swamp), so the trigger never appears in the trace. Packs on the live tree and on this packet's tree: H00_5 (a Forest of mine and a Swamp the opponent plays trigger nothing and ask nothing), H00_6 (a Swamp put onto the battlefield by an effect triggers it), H00_7 (the mode ask offers exactly the two modes), H00_1-H00_4, H00_8. After the survivors run: H00_9 (two Swamps put onto the battlefield by one effect, Brought Back, trigger twice: two mode choices, two cards drawn, 18 life).

clauses.clause: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
clauses.evidence: Tree: Seq(DRAW 1 YOU, LOSE_LIFE 1 YOU), option 0. Never triggered in the trace. H00_1 (mode 0 after a played Swamp: exactly one card drawn from my own library, life 19, nothing damaged, opponent's library untouched), H00_6 (same through an effect-entered Swamp).

clauses.clause: This creature deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
clauses.evidence: Tree: Seq(DEAL_DAMAGE 2 to FOr(Creature, Planeswalker, Player) TARGET, GAIN_LIFE 2 YOU), option 1. Never triggered in the trace. H00_2 (an opponent's 3/3 gets exactly 2 marked, I go to 22, nobody draws), H00_3 (the opponent player goes to 18), H00_4 (my own 4/4 and the opponent's planeswalker, 5 -> 3 loyalty, are legal targets), H00_8 (the source destroyed in response: the ability still deals 2 and gains 2, CR 113.7a).

survived: each occurrence -> once per event at 1/0
